title: Violation of Bell-type Inequalities on Mutually-commuting von Neumann Algebra Models of Entanglement Swapping Networks
summary: Violation of Bell inequalities in bipartite systems represented by mutually-commuting von Neumann algebras has pioneered the study of vacuum entanglement in algebraic quantum field theory. It is unexpected that the maximal violation of Bell inequality can discover algebraic structures. In the paper, we establish the mutually-commuting von Neumann algebra model for entanglement swapping networks and Bell-type inequalities on this model. It generalizes the bipartite case to the ternary case. These algebras are all general von Neumann algebras, which provide a natural perspective to investigate…
